name: cbp-react-stack
description: The React-family stack toolbox (#187 distribution pilot, first Tier-2 stack pack): framework-aware helpers the workflow plugins pick up automatically in React / Next.js / React Native projects — vitest-dev and jest-dev test runners, nextjs-dev, react-test-patterns, and the React Native dev/E2E skills. Install alongside cbp-build-test-workflows so test-pipeline uses the stack-aware path instead of the generic one.
